body:
So the story is I had a 3-hour long trip ahead of me and I wanted to skip it, by sleeping through it.
I got a little drunk but it did me no good. I was far too awake. I decided to take some prescription Minitran tablets which have 4mg perphenazine (antipsychotic) and 10mg amitriptyline (antidepressant) each.
Other times I've used it in the past 2 tablets made me really drowsy and 3 made sleep easy.
Like the impatient drunk bastard I was, I thought It was a good idea to down 10 of them. Sometime later I was TELEPORTED to my destination, almost losing my stop.
I struggled to get to my friends home, walking like a damn zombie and forgetting my jacket on the bus.
My mouth was completely dry and I barely kept my eyes open. When I finally was there my friend realized how drugged I was and got me to a bed.
Then the weirdest thing happened: I started seeing thin colored bolts of thunder (the best I can describe it) when I had my eyes closed.
Time seemed to fly until long into the night where I think the drug started wearing off because I finally felt that I fucked up. I started fearing that I will stop breathing in my sleep and not make it through the night.
The fatigue, dread, and weakness carried on to the next day (I also had some trouble peeing) gradually diminishing with the fatigue being the first to go and dread the last, which finally disappeared the following morning.
I know what happened was completely my fault and I never used Minitran ever since. Thankfully I had no long-lasting effects (at least I hope so).
